Larry Summers Jeffrey Epstein Harvard — EFTA02239873, EFTA02239649.

March 2018, a decade after Epstein's guilty plea, his office is arranging a Harvard Sunday around Larry Summers: "Jeffrey is planning a trip up to Harvard this Sunday March 25th… might Larry be around and available to meet with him?" Groff's memo the next day tracks Summers's flight back from Beijing so the schedule can bend around him. Epstein's Harvard millions landed while Summers was the university's president (2001–2006). "Larry Summers" appears in 5,378 documents in the releases — the biggest name count we've run.

Reid Hoffman Jeffrey Epstein island flight — EFTA02300238.

November 28, 2014: Epstein's assistant Lesley Groff emails Reid Hoffman and Joi Ito the pilot's details for Sunday's flight — from Jeffrey's island to Bedford, Massachusetts — and asks for "Joi's and Reid's US home addresses" for customs pre-clearance. Nine months earlier, a travel itinerary titled "Vancouver -> Island" went out with Hoffman's name on it. Hoffman apologized in 2019 for helping Epstein raise his profile and confirmed one island visit. "Reid Hoffman" appears in 2,818 documents in the releases.

Steve Bannon Jeffrey Epstein Ehud Barak dinner — EFTA02240144, Epstein's own calendar.

Thursday, March 22, 2018: 5:00pm appointment with Ehud. 6:00pm appointment with Steve Bannon. 7:30pm dinner with Ehud and Bannon. 8:30pm: "Miro to join the dinner." Next morning: breakfast with Leon Black. Seven months after Bannon left the White House, a convicted sex offender's calendar lists him for an appointment, then dinner with Israel's former prime minister. A schedule is a plan, not proof everyone showed up — the archive publishes it as a plan. "Steve Bannon" appears in 1,891 documents in the releases. This is Epstein's own schedule page.
